policies: Reuse parent model, preprocessing, low/high scales and calibration radii unchanged
source: Parent development inputs only; no original FlipGuard inputs
shift: First 256 development inputs plus iid Gaussian noise sigma=0.5 in standardized model space, clip to [-5,5]
boundary: 32 pairs with opposite plaintext class from development; 48 bisection steps; evaluate interpolations at offsets [-0.01,-0.0001,-0.000001,0,0.000001,0.0001,0.01] along each segment, clip to [-5,5]
limits: Synthetic inputs have no ground-truth labels or real distribution guarantee. Report agreement with frozen polynomial reference only. Preserve calibration-envelope exceedances and failures; never tune from stress results.
